title: The Well w/ Dr. Wendi
author: Wendi Williams
description:
The Well is a wellness-centered leadership podcast for leaders who are tired — not of the work, but from carrying it.


Dr. Wendi Williams has spent two decades in the rooms where the hardest decisions get made. She has led institutions through turnaround and crisis as a senior leader in higher education, carried fiduciary weight as a board chair across the nonprofit and for-profit sectors, and trained as a counseling psychologist who reads what sits beneath the leadership — the part no one names aloud. She is the current President of the American Psychological Association. Her work is grounded in Black Women's Liberatory Leadership (BWLL) Praxis, a framework that transcends identity to offer a universal blueprint for leaders committed to impact, equity, and sustainable transformation.


She knows what it costs to lead, because she has carried it.


Some weeks, you'll sit with a leader whose story of being pushed out, worn down, and finding their way back illuminates where you are now. Other weeks, Dr. Wendi turns to the research and to your questions directly, translating what the evidence means for your leadership, this week, in your life. Either way, every episode opens the same: a moment to center, research woven in rather than lectured, and one real thing you can use — whether you lead a company, a classroom, an office, or a home.


Seeking support is the beginning of the most important leadership work you will ever do.


Welcome to The Well. You are welcome here, exactly as you are.


Learn more at https://www.drwendiwilliams.com/

title: Kincade and Chernoff

description:

title: The Economic Globe
author: The Economic Globe
description:
We spend our lives trying to earn money—but where does it actually go?
In our first episode, we follow money from where it comes from to what happens when we spend it, exploring money creation, the velocity of money, MV = PY, inflation, and why earning more doesn’t always mean feeling richer. We also look at lifestyle inflation and why our idea of “enough” keeps changing. 
This is economics, but beyond the textbook.
Isa and Aarush

Hosted by therapist and creator Akilah Peters, each episode blends meaning and ease, depth and laughter, with honest conversations that meet you right where you are and invite you forward. Light Work Era blends emotional wellness with real life , love, ambition, grief, motherhood, healing and living a life that actually feels light.
This is not about fixing yourself.
It’s about recognizing who you already are without the heaviness of pressure or perfection.

description: Hinesights Podcast: Heal. Connect. Inspire. title: Miami Mystery: The Disappearance of Olavi Hendrickson
author: Dover Road Media
description:
Miami Mystery is a true crime podcast in which Emmy Award winning journalist Dana Dean reopens the unexplained disappearance of her own grandfather, Miami City Attorney Olavi Hendrickson. In October 1962, Hendrickson walked out of his home in a black suit and never came back. No body, no death certificate, no record of a missing person investigation. 


Joined by her sister, Dean's five year investigation, built on FOIA requests, archival newspaper research, a long hidden letter, and exclusive family interviews, uncovers a story that upends what her family believed for six decades. 


The series explores organized crime in 1960s Miami, political corruption, and family secrets, following two sisters' search for the truth about their own grandfather.

title: Three Vet Techs in a Holistic World

description: Pet vitality, holistic care, and life beyond the vet visit. VECC Voices is the official podcast of the Salt Lake Valley Emergency Communications Center. Go beyond the headset and meet the people who make SLVECC what it is.
Each episode spotlights our members, shares their journeys, celebrates the incredible work happening throughout our organization, and explores the future of emergency communications. title: Diary of a developing Medium
author: Alex D
description:
NZ 🇳🇿😍
This podcast follows my wild, rapid & completely unexpected spiritual awakening — from feeling there had to be something bigger than us, to developing incredible spiritual abilities in just one year.
Expect unique storytelling, humour & plenty of "what the actual eff" moments, as I share my experiences about connecting with spirits, guides, orbs, synchronicities, chakras, Reiki, the Akashic Records, meditation, shadow work & everything in between; and try to make sense of a journey I never expected! title: Heartwired: Love, Heartbreak & Everything In Between
author: Dona
description:
Heartwired explores the complicated, messy, and often misunderstood world of relationships, identity, and human behavior. Through honest conversations about love, betrayal, healing, manipulation, and growth, we unpack the stories we tell ourselves and the truths we sometimes avoid.

This isn’t about having all the answers. It’s about asking better questions, having uncomfortable conversations, and understanding what makes us human.

Each episode takes listeners beyond simple summaries to discover the stories, characters, emotions, questions, and human experiences that make books meaningful. From unforgettable fiction and thoughtful nonfiction to timeless classics and modern voices, the podcast looks at what books can teach us about people, relationships, choices, imagination, culture, and everyday life. Whether you read every day or simply enjoy discovering a good story, Between the Covers offers a relaxed and thoughtful journey through the pages that shape the way we see the world.

title: Book Club with the C-Suite
author: WashingtonExec
description:
What actually shapes the minds of today’s top leaders? Book Club with the C-Suite goes beyond resumes, corporate titles, and executive handbooks to deliver high-impact leadership insights—one book at a time.


Hosted by Amanda Ziadeh and produced by WashingtonExec, each short-form, 20-minute episode features candid conversations with C-suite executives about a fiction or nonfiction book that fundamentally altered their perspective, redefined their leadership style, or guided them through crucial turning points in their careers.


Inside every 20-minute episode, you’ll discover:

  • Go-To Recommendations: The transformative books top executives consistently pass along to peers and rising leaders.
  • Real-World Application: How literary concepts translate into practical strategies for managing teams, driving innovation, and navigating uncertainty.
  • Candid Insights: Deep, reflective dialogues connecting big leadership theories to authentic, lived executive experience.


Whether you're an aspiring manager or a seasoned enterprise leader, tune in for a rare, accessible look at how the industry’s most influential leaders think, grow, and lead.

Subscribe now to build your leadership bookshelf.

title: The Surplus Funds Podcast
author: Eric Richardson
description:
Welcome to the Surplus Funds Podcast, hosted by Eric Richardson—your go-to source for learning how to uncover, understand, and profit from surplus funds recovery.

This podcast breaks down the real opportunity behind unclaimed money left over after foreclosure and tax sales—and how you can step in to help individuals claim what’s rightfully theirs while building a powerful income stream.

Inside each episode, you’ll learn:

What surplus funds are and why they exist
How to find and verify real opportunities nationwide
Step-by-step claim processes (tax sales & mortgage foreclosures)
Proven marketing and outreach strategies that actually convert
How to close deals and structure your fees
Systems, automation, and scaling with tools like CRMs
Legal insights and when to use attorneys

Whether you’re just getting started or already closing deals, this podcast gives you the game—from lead to check.

If you’re ready to tap into a multi-billion dollar opportunity while making a real impact, this is where you learn how to do it the right way.

Tune in, take action, and start claiming what others leave behind.

title: Vinyl & Vanishing Years
author: John James
description: Vinyl & Vanishing Years is a journey through the forgotten corners of music history. Each episode uncovers the people, places, recordings, movements, and cultural moments that quietly shaped the sound of different generations. From unexpected musical collaborations and forgotten scenes to changing technology and the evolution of listening culture, the podcast explores how music survives, transforms, and finds its way into new eras. It is a storytelling-focused look at the history behind the sounds we still hear today.

title: Revolve around Healthcare
author: Revolve Healthcare
description:
Conversations shaping successful medical software.
The podcast for MedTech leaders building and scaling software-driven medical devices. We explore the decisions behind designing, developing, and scaling compliant medical software: from SaMD and SiMD, to connected devices. Each episode brings together experts across business, R&D, regulatory, and product leadership to share practical insights on MDR/IVDR, FDA, cybersecurity, AI, and the challenges shaping modern MedTech.
Hosted by Przemek Grzywa, co-CEO of Revolve Healthcare, an ISO 13485-certified medical software development partner.

title: Naturism, Nudism and Gymnosophy for the BARE-ly Curious
author: Naomi Gale
description:
Naturism for the BARE-ly Curious: Nudism & Gymnosophy. A nudist podcast show for anyone who's ever been curious about naturism. This isn't the nudist club version of naturism. It's the one where we get honest about naturism in the modern world. Each episode sits with what nudism and naturism actually feel like: the body, the freedom, the awkward moments, the surprising ordinariness of being naked once you begin. We explore BARE-ly through gymnosophy: the century-old philosophy of nakedness and wisdom that most people have never heard of. Consent, confidence, shame, curiosity, and the long, quietly radical history of people, especially women who have always explored the joy of choosing to bare all, some or nothing. You don't need to be a naturist to listen. You just need to be BARE-ly curious.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Scars and Stripes: Unfiltered
author: Scars and Stripes
description: Scars and Stripes Unfiltered is about telling the veteran story the way it actually is—without polishing it up, watering it down, or pretending the hard parts don’t exist. Created through Scars and Stripes Inc., Unfiltered provides a platform for honest conversations about military service, transitioning back into civilian life, homelessness, mental health, suicide prevention, addiction and recovery, relationships, anger, financial struggles, navigating the VA, and the everyday challenges veterans and their families face. This isn’t about portraying veterans as broken, helpless, or statistics. It’s about real people, real scars, real struggles, and real victories. The goal is to have conversations that others may be afraid to have, challenge the stigma surrounding asking for help, connect veterans with resources, and remind people that prevention starts long before someone reaches a crisis. No scripts. No sugarcoating. No judgment. Just veterans, advocates, community partners, and real people having real conversations.

title: Good Morning, and Praise the Lord
author: James Newcomb
description: Good Morning, and Praise the Lord is a daily reflection on faith, meaning, community, and the presence of God in ordinary life.  Each episode follows a simple rhythm: Notice. Consider. Carry.  Notice begins with something worth paying attention to—a story, question, encounter, or moment that might otherwise pass unnoticed.  Consider looks beneath the surface, drawing from Scripture, Christian tradition, history, conversation, and lived experience to ask what that moment might reveal.  Carry brings the reflection back into daily life: one thought, conviction, or question worth taking with you into the day ahead.  Rooted in the ancient Christian tradition but spoken in the language of everyday life, Good Morning, and Praise the Lord is an invitation to begin the day with greater attention—to God, to one another, and to what may be happening just beneath the surface of the ordinary.

We’re talking life, relationships, culture, sports, creativity and whatever somehow ends up getting brought up. Nobody here is an expert. We’re just talking like family does. We might have a point. We might be loud and wrong. Either way, we could be wrong.

title: The Hard Shit We Don't Talk About

description: Ever wonder why you never feel like you’re enough, why setting boundaries makes you feel guilty, or why you keep repeating the same relationship patterns? Each episode breaks down the people, processes, standards, decisions, and field practicies that determine whether a fiber network get built right the first time or becomes somebody else's problem later.

From architecture and interiors to graphic design, products, fashion, digital experiences, and everyday objects, the podcast looks at how design influences the way we see, use, and experience the world around us. Each episode goes beyond appearance to explore the stories, decisions, problems, and creative thinking that turn an ordinary idea into something meaningful and useful.

description:
Step into the world of the Bible through powerful stories, forgotten details, timeless lessons, and fascinating mysteries. Bible Stories brings ancient scriptures to life through immersive storytelling designed to inspire reflection, strengthen faith, and uncover the deeper meaning behind some of history’s most unforgettable stories.
From the lives of prophets and kings to miracles, battles, mysteries, and moments of divine intervention, each episode takes you on a journey through the biblical world.
🎙️ Listen. Reflect. Discover the stories that shaped generations.

title: Hire a Game Dev Partner: What to Know
author: Emma Johnson
description: In this episode, we break down how to hire the right Video Game Development partner. Our guest explains the difference between building a game yourself and outsourcing to professionals. We cover what to look for in a studio, how contracts work, and simple collaboration tips to keep your project on track.

title: TechBBQ'26: The Podcast
author: The BuildingBusiness Podcast
description:
The BuildingBusiness Podcast returns to TechBBQ for the third year in a row — recording live from the conference floor in Copenhagen.

Across two packed days, we sit down with founders, investors, operators, innovators and the people actually building what comes next.

The format is simple: no polished corporate pitches, no rehearsed answers and no generic panel talk. Just real conversations about what people are building, what is working, what is failing, what they have learned along the way, and where they believe their industries are heading next.

Recorded live at TechBBQ ’26 on August 26–27, the series captures the energy, ideas and people behind one of the Nordics’ most important startup and technology gatherings.

*Connecting founders. Building the future.*

title: Lighthouse by Dragonfly
author: Lighthouse by Dragonfly
description:
Lighthouse by Dragonfly is a calm place for caregivers carrying more than most people can see.
Through honest stories from my own caregiving journey, I share the difficult moments, practical lessons, questions I learned to ask, and hope we found along the way. We’ll talk about recognizing change, searching for answers, navigating treatment, working with the healthcare system, and remembering the person behind the diagnosis.
My husband is a private man, so some names, locations, dates, and personal details will remain private. I share our experiences while protecting his privacy and dignity.

title: Executing My Exodus Ministries
author: Ashley Dickens
description:
EME was born from one simple but powerful idea:
Your bondage does not have to become your permanent address.
Executing My Exodus Ministries exists to help believers navigate the journey out of bondage and toward healing, spiritual recovery, growth, freedom, and transformation through biblical truth and honest conversation.
This ministry isn't about pretending that freedom happens overnight. It's about learning how to walk it out — one decision, one truth, one prayer, one step at a time.
We are moving From Bondage to Breakthrough — One Step at a Time.

title: ReDiscovering Black and Asian Solidarity
author: Black and Asian Solidarity Collective
description:
In a world that too often tries to divide and position communities against one another, ReDiscovering Black and Asian Solidarity offers a warm, grounded space for genuine connection. Hosted by Dr. Yolanda Sealey-Ruiz and Dr. Judy Yu, this podcast embraces storytelling as liberation, uplifting marginalized voices to explore the deep historic roots and daily practices that weave Black and Asian communities together. The series serves as a vibrant anti-racist coalition in audio form. By exploring intersectionality, collective care, and shared histories of struggle, the hosts and their guests craft powerful counter-narratives that reject division, creating a roadmap for true coalition building and lasting Black and Asian Solidarity.

Supported by the Digital Futures Institute at Teachers College, Columbia University.

title: The Law Office of Ryan Besinque's Podcast

description:
Worth Working For! is a podcast about how great teams build trust. Each episode, I sit down with people building something that matters and find out why it matters to them and what it creates for the people around them. We talk about building trust, setting the right work environment, and becoming a leader worth working for.
Hosted by Greg Hoffman, lawyer, executive coach, and author of Performance Through People.

title: Zero Cost Side Hustle: Start Earning Today
author: Lazy Hustle
description:
Want to earn money but have ₹0 to start? In this episode, we explore powerful side hustles that need no investment — just your time, skills, and smartphone. From affiliate marketing to reselling, content creation to offering digital services, we’ll cover everything you need to begin today. Whether you're a student, homemaker, or just looking to build an income stream from scratch, this episode will give you real ideas with real steps — all without spending a rupee!
💡 What You’ll Learn:
5 legit side hustles you can start with ₹0
How to use your phone and free tools to earn
Common mistakes

title: Practical Peace (DEMO)
author: Eugene Chan
description:
Does finding peace mean losing your drive?

Trevor Shin and Minh explore how Zen practice fits into working life: pursuing goals, planning for the future, being present with other people, and responding when things do not go your way.

They discuss why presence can include planning, what it means to give your best without tying your identity to an outcome, and how practice and community can help you return to the moment.

If this conversation resonates, share it with someone who is trying to do meaningful work without losing their peace along the way.

title: The Joy Challenge
author: Joy Specht
description: The Joy Challenge is encouragement, learning, and practical exercises to build your joy! We break things down into baby steps and elements that lead to more joy. Take one podcast at a time and practice!  Before you know it,  your heart has space to experience what it longs for!

title: Women In Music Technology
author: Alexa Bond
description:
What does it really mean to be a woman in music technology?
Join me, a sixth form student, as I speak to inspiring women working across the music and audio industry, from live sound and touring, to music production, recording, acoustics, engineering and experimental sound.
Through honest conversations, I explore their career journeys, experiences, challenges, achievements and advice for the next generation. Discover the women working behind the scenes, breaking boundaries and shaping the future of music technology.

title: The Psychedelic News Feed

description:
Psychological Abuse and Its Effects on Physical and Mental Health
A groundbreaking investigation offering a definitive plan for recognizing and overcoming intimate partner violence and the breadth of its impact.
Loving You Shouldn't Be Hurting Me: Psychological Abuse and Its Effects on Physical and Mental Health is dedicated to women worldwide, of whom nearly half in the United States (or approximately 57.6 million women) have experienced psychological aggression. This invisible cruelty is the underpinning for all other forms of mistreatment, making it the most difficult obstacle from which to recover. Moreover, clinical research indicates that subtle psychological abuse inflicts the most devastating damage. This book addresses the global crisis head-on.
Anyone trapped in an unhealthy, toxic, or controlling relationship will find a clear path forward in this book, whether the relationship is ongoing, long over, or rooted in childhood trauma. Those who have experienced physical or mental health symptoms as a result of this chronic manipulation will find immediate validation and a comprehensive roadmap on how to truly heal the mind, body, and spirit.
While statistics show women are more likely to experience the adverse physical and emotional effects of abuse—and are historically more likely to seek out self-help resources—this work is inclusive of all kinds of trauma. Drawing on a career that has been devoted to helping all survivors heal, Dr. Neal also explicitly addresses how men and children are impacted by the sweeping devastation of psychological abuse.

author: Michal Baum
description:
הפודקאסט של מיכל באום ואורית כהן
מה באמת מסתתר מאחורי המראה?
מאחורי הבגד שבחרנו, מאחורי הסטייל, מאחורי המחמאה שקיבלנו, ומאחורי הדרך שבה אנחנו מציגות את עצמנו לעולם – יש סיפור.
”מאחורי המראה” הוא פודקאסט על נשים, ביטחון עצמי, דימוי עצמי, סטייל, יופי וכל מה שביניהם. אבל יותר מכל, הוא פודקאסט על החיים עצמם.
בכל פרק נדבר על הנושאים שמעסיקים נשים בכל גיל ובכל שלב בחיים: איך אנחנו רואות את עצמנו, איך אנחנו רוצות להרגיש, מה משפיע על הביטחון שלנו, איך אופנה וסטייל יכולים להיות כלי לביטוי אישי, ומה קורה כשאנחנו מפסיקות להתמקד רק במה שרואים מבחוץ ומתחילות להתחבר למה שקורה בפנים.
אנחנו מביאות לשולחן שיחות פתוחות, כנות ומעשיות, המבוססות על שנים של עבודה עם נשים, לצד תובנות, סיפורים, חוויות וכלים שיכולים לעזור לכל אישה להרגיש טוב יותר עם עצמה.
אני מיכל באום, סטייליסטית ובעלת בית אופנה לנשים, המאמינה שלבוש הוא הרבה יותר מבגד – הוא דרך לבטא נוכחות, ביטחון ותחושת ערך.
ואני אורית כהן, סטייליסטית ומלווה נשים בתהליכי סטיילינג אישי, דימוי עצמי ובניית סגנון אישי.
ביחד יצרנו את ”מאחורי המראה” – מקום שבו אופנה היא רק נקודת ההתחלה, והשיחה האמיתית היא על האישה שמאחוריה.
אם גם את מאמינה שיופי מתחיל בתחושה, שביטחון עצמי הוא תהליך, ושיש הרבה יותר מאחורי מה שרואים במראה – הפודקאסט הזה בשבילך.
אנחנו מזמינות אותך להצטרף אלינו למסע של השראה, גילוי עצמי, סטייל, צמיחה ושיחות מהלב.

title: 21 Days in India (Satirical Tales of the British Raj)
author: George Robert Aberigh-Mackay
description:
Sir Ali Baba, a hapless British bureaucrat, finds himself entangled in the absurdities of colonial India, navigating a world where the rules of British etiquette clash hilariously with local customs. In "Twenty-one Days in India," George Robert Aberigh-Mackay crafts a witty collection of satirical tales that expose the eccentricities of the British Raj through the eyes of its bewildered officials. From baffling bureaucratic procedures to outlandish social gatherings, each story unravels the comedic chaos that ensues when cultures collide.

Join Sir Ali as he encounters a cast of colorful characters, including pompous generals, scheming merchants, and bewildered locals, all while attempting to maintain his dignity in a landscape rife with contradictions. Each chapter offers a fresh dose of humor, revealing the folly of colonial arrogance and the rich tapestry of Indian life, making listeners laugh while prompting thoughtful reflection on the complexities of empire.

With sharp wit and keen observation, Aberigh-Mackay invites you to explore the absurdities of a time long past, yet eerily relevant today. Will Sir Ali ever find his footing amidst the chaos? Tune in to discover the hilarity and unexpected insights of this unique journey through the heart of India during the Raj. Perfect for fans of historical humor, cultural satire, and anyone looking for a delightful escape into a world where laughter reigns supreme.

title: Pendeja Podcast
author: Lisa La Boriqua
description:
The Pendeja Podcast was created purposely to get your ATTENTION.
Depending on where you are from in Latin America, this word can mean the plant (El Pendejo - Spinossum alyssum), a funny reference among friends, or something very offensive.
The Pendeja Podcast stands on 5 pillars:
*COMMUNITY
*ENTERTAINMENT
*EMPOWERMENT
*ENTREPRENUERSHIP
*COMMUNITY REINVESTMENT
At its core, the Pendeja Podcast is a platform celebrating and featuring members of our community. We share success stories and invite entrepreneurs who merit a shining light of awareness and recognition.
One thing all people can relate to are mistakes and important lessons we learn along the way to help us reach our goals.
These elements of trial and error or “mistakes” ... we refer to as “Pendejadas”.
Sharing our “Pendejadas” is a fun way to laugh at ourselves and our life lessons and welcome others to laugh WITH us. The Pendeja Podcast allows you to make fun of yourself and not someone else.
Over time we look forward to making the word “Pendeja” only funny and never offensive, globally.
Thank you again for your comments as it means that you care.

title: The Anxious for Nothing Podcast

description:
Welcome to the Anxious for Nothing Podcast. 

"Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God. [7] And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus. -Philippians 4:6–7

We live in anxious times where we are bombarded by the problems of this life, the news and social media. It can make one feel anxious and depressed when we read the news, face challenges in this life. Our gaze is too often focused on what is before us. We lose sight of Who is above us. When that happens, we can fall into despair. Let us look to Jesus when the storms come and when life seems chaotic, let us stop and remember who is truly Sovereign. 

The goal of this Podcast is encourage the weary pilgrim and like many, I need it too.

title: Tim: A Story of School Life (Friendship and Unrequited Love)
author: Howard Overing Sturgis
description:
Tim struggles under the weight of his father's disappointment, feeling like he can never quite measure up. When he forms a bond with the strong, confident older boy, Jack, it becomes a lifeline for him in the turbulent world of school life. This relationship offers Tim a glimpse of acceptance and camaraderie, but as they grow older, the dynamics shift in ways Tim never anticipated. The closeness fades, yet Tim’s feelings linger, pushing him into a journey of self-discovery and emotional resilience.

In "Tim: A Story of School Life," Howard Overing Sturgis takes listeners through the trials and tribulations of adolescence, exploring themes of friendship, unrequited love, and the harsh realities of growing up. As Tim navigates the complexities of his emotions, he learns to reconcile his longing for connection with the reality of his changing relationship with Jack. Will Tim find the strength to embrace who he is, despite the challenges that life throws his way?

This audiobook invites you into a poignant exploration of youth, heartache, and the bonds that shape us. Perfect for anyone who remembers the bittersweet moments of school days, "Tim" offers a rich tapestry of experiences that resonate far beyond the classroom. Join Tim on his heartfelt journey, and discover the lessons that linger long after the final bell rings.

All are welcome, and anyone who identifies as an alcoholic should be able to hear their story.  This podcast is a version of a specialty meeting such as a men's, women's, or freethinkers meeting.  Some content was recorded in meetings that were closed for those who identify as Black or are part of the African Diaspora.  


There is some explicit language, discussion of racial trauma, and other trauma related content that may be triggering for some.  All listeners reserve the right to stop listening to an episode or decide this podcast is not for you.  Importantly, we are sharing our own experience, strength, and hope and do not speak for Alcoholics Anonymous.  Please take what you like and leave the rest.  Also, this podcast is not for profit and will always be free to whoever wants it.

title: Under Review: The Verification Project
author: Cody Clark
description:
Under Review: The Verification Project explores the questions, claims, and assumptions that shape how we understand our world.

Each investigation begins with a question—not a conclusion. We develop a hypothesis, then do our best to break it. We examine primary sources, historical records, data, expert scholarship, competing interpretations, and the strongest evidence against our own position.


Sometimes the evidence leads to a clear answer. Sometimes it challenges what we thought we knew. And sometimes the most accurate conclusion is simply: we don't know.


No predetermined verdicts. No hiding inconvenient evidence. No asking you to take our word for it.

From religion and history to science, business, culture, and society, each episode follows the evidence wherever it leads—and publishes the research behind the discussion so you can examine it for yourself.


Because the goisn't to prove we're right.

It's to find out whether an idea survives being put Under Review.

Bigger questions. Deeper evidence. A clearer world.

Don't take our word for it. Verify it.

title: Baseball Hall of Fame Lives
author: Mark Treichel
description:
Every member of the Baseball Hall of Fame gets a bronze plaque in Cooperstown. This show tells the rest of the story.

Baseball Hall of Fame Lives is a narrative biography podcast. Each episode covers one Hall of Famer, start to finish: where they came from, how they made it, what it cost them, and what happened after the cheering stopped. It isn't an interview show, and it doesn't debate who deserves a plaque. It tells a life.

You'll hear the names you know, like Roberto Clemente, Harmon Killebrew and Andruw Jones. You'll also hear the ones you don't: Negro Leagues pioneers, nineteenth-century stars, executives, umpires and managers, many of whose stories almost nobody tells anymore. Those are often the best episodes.

Each episode is researched from the historical record, and when a famous story turns out to be wrong, the episode says so.

Baseball history, one Hall of Famer at a time.

Baseball Hall of Fame Lives is an independent production and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Baseball Hall of Fame and Museum.

title: Being Human in the Age of Data and AI
author: Jordan_Morrow
description:
In a world where algorithms predict choices, data dictates decisions, and AI redefines work, what does it mean to safeguard our humanity?

Being Human in the Age of Data and AI explores the intersection of AI, machine intelligence, human agency, and data. Hosted by a pioneer in the data literacy movement, this show moves past technological hype and alarmist narratives to examine how clear thinking, context, and curiosity help us navigate an automated future.

Data literacy is no longer just a technical requirement for analysts; it is a foundational life skill for every individual. Each episode unpacks how we can move from passive consumers of algorithmic outputs to active, critical decision-makers. The show examines:

  • Data Literacy as Human Empowerment: Elevating data fluency from spreadsheet skills to critical thinking, contextual awareness, and narrative questioning.

  • Agency in the Algorithmic Era: Practical strategies to maintain autonomy, privacy, and authentic judgment alongside rapidly evolving AI tools.

  • Uniquely Human Capabilities: Double-downing on intuition, nuance, empathy, and ethical reasoning—the essential traits synthetic systems cannot replicate.

  • Societal & Organizational Impact: How data-driven transformations alter workplace culture, leadership, education, and personal identity.

Whether you are an executive steering an enterprise through AI adoption, an educator preparing students for a tech-driven landscape, or a curious thinker seeking digital well-being, this podcast offers grounded insights and actionable wisdom for living purposefully alongside technology.

Big Summer is a serialized memoir drawn from that journal, preserving the intelligence, absurdity, anxiety and startling intimacy of the original voice.


This isn’t 1989 remembered from a distance. It’s 1989 while it was still happening.

description:

The Putneys believe in letting children learn through experience, a concept that shakes Betsy's understanding of safety and rules.

As Betsy navigates her new surroundings, she encounters a world filled with farm chores, wild adventures, and unexpected friendships. Will she embrace the freedom of her new life, or will the shadow of her past hold her back?
